rendered_capture.scope: Scrolled inspector shows both inclusive bounds, one detected/saved cell, frozen 81–90 sample recipe, captured calibration and successful one-row CSV export. Windows clamps requested window height; capture uses actual framebuffer.

calibration_stale_issue.description: Active physical requests remained publishable after live calibration changed; discovered by the managed-viewer native test and independently reproduced for direct requests, including enabled zero bounds.
calibration_stale_issue.fix: Capture the calibration revision for active physical requests and include it in matches(); ordinary sampled requests and archived replay retain their existing semantics.
